meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: TZJ Privacy Policy — learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

sections.title: 1. Information Collection
sections.body: We may collect personal information you voluntarily provide when visiting this website or submitting information through contact forms, including but not limited to name, email address, phone number, and company/organization name.

sections.title: 2. Information Use
sections.body: Collected information is used only for: responding to your inquiries and requests, providing product and technical support, sending product information (with your consent), and improving website service experience.

sections.title: 3. Information Protection
sections.body: We implement reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your personal information. We will not sell, rent, or disclose your personal information to third parties without your consent.

sections.title: 4. Cookie Usage
sections.body: This website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

sections.title: 5. Policy Updates
sections.body: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Updated policies will be posted on this page. We recommend reviewing periodically for the latest information.

contactSection.title: 6. Contact Us
contactSection.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
